dataset: Aga Khan University OPG folder 2: 96 films never used in training (Zenodo 10538750, CC BY 4.0)
model: yolo11m, trained on DENTEX then fine-tuned on Aga Khan folders 1 and 3
note: Better on unseen Aga Khan films (+8.2 points found-with-correct-number); 2.1 points lower on the DENTEX official test set (some forgetting). Combined over 4,180 teeth: 92.2 % vs 87.8 %.
